verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a 'customizable chart of accounts' that accountants can update. The journal-entries API references a Get Accounts endpoint that returns account UUIDs, so basic chart-of-accounts customization is evidenced. Nothing in the pack shows how far that customization goes, and the specific elements the story names are absent. Missing for 10: evidence of configurable account types, sub-account hierarchy, class/tag/dimension tracking, in-depth chart-of-accounts docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
